title: AIDA: An AI Outage Registry with Evidence from On-Chain MEV
abstract: arXiv:2611.01656v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative AI coding tools have lowered the cost of writing trading software, but no systematic dataset records when these services fail. We introduce the AI Incident and Disruption Archive (AIDA), a multi-vendor registry of 5,868 deduplicated outage incidents across 30 providers from 2025 to 2026, with foundation-model incidents verified against primary status-page or postmortem URLs. Pairing AIDA with 5,041,034 verified maximal extractable value (MEV) transactions by 8,516 Ethereum addresses, their contract creations, and a 22-month Base Layer-2 panel of 1,099,593,191 swaps and 29,120 private executors, we establish two findings. First, entry into MEV expanded where code and public state suffice, as active arbitrage addresses quadrupled from late 2024 to late 2026 and liquidators grew by a third, while sandwich attackers, who need private order flow and builder access, declined. translated_title: AIDA：基于链上MEV证据的AI服务中断登记系统
translated_abstract: 生成式AI编程工具降低了编写交易软件的成本，但目前尚无系统性数据集记录这些服务何时发生故障。我们提出了AI事件与中断档案（AIDA），这是一个涵盖2025年至2026年间30家供应商共5,868条去重后中断事件的多供应商登记库，其中基础模型相关事件均通过与原始状态页面或事后分析报告的URL进行了核验。将AIDA与8,516个以太坊地址的5,041,034笔经验证的最大可提取价值（MEV）交易及其合约创建记录，以及一个为期22个月、包含1,099,593,191笔交换交易和29,120个私人执行者的Base二层网络面板数据相结合，我们确立了两个发现。第一，在代码与公开状态信息即可满足需求的情况下，MEV领域的准入规模显著扩张——活跃套利地址数量从2024年底到2026年底增长了四倍，清算者数量增长了三分之一，而依赖私人订单流和构建者访问权限的三明治攻击者数量则有所下降。尽管如此，执行环节仍然保持高度集中……
tldr: 该论文创建了首个系统性记录AI服务故障的多供应商登记数据库AIDA，并结合链上MEV交易数据证明：在仅需代码和公开信息的领域，AI编程工具降低了准入成本、显著扩大了MEV参与者的进入，而依赖私人资源的参与者减少且执行仍高度集中。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AIDA, the first systematic multi-vendor registry of AI service outages, and uses on-chain MEV evidence to show that AI coding tools lowered entry costs and expanded MEV participation where code and public state suffice, while reliance on private resources declined and execution remained concentrated.
